context: Asuka and Ren discuss a lecture on rights.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture discussion; vocabulary (依頼/定め/訴え/優れ/講義) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨日の講義、とても優れていました。
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ありがとう。依頼されて、話したんです。
lines.en: Thank you. I was asked to give it.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 権利は、法で定められるんですね。
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、法が、権利を細かく定めます。
lines.en: Yes, law sets rights in detail.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人々は、何を訴えてきたんですか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平等を、長く訴えてきました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の講義の、依頼もあるんですか?
lines.en: Is there a request for the next lecture too?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 優れた問いを、講義で扱いたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to address excellent questions in the lecture.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
